text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The day of the Sprinters Stakes. Tokai 
Teio is seen in the stands, standing with 
a mixture of anticipation and anxiety.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Yamanin Zephyr is unusually nervous. 
Daiichi Ruby's sheer presence is truly 
formidable, after all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, Tokai Teio was sure to be 
watching. Fired up, she vowed not to 
deliver a pathetic performance.
